name: dsh-novel-txt-editor

description.en: Editable plain text in the DSH right sidebar: a .txt file opened in a document tab renders as a textarea with character/line counts, Ctrl+S save, reload, and a version guard that refuses to overwrite a file changed on disk meanwhile. Read and write go through the plugin's own Host routes, limited to registered workspaces, preserving CRLF and BOM.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏直接编辑 .txt：文档标签里的纯文本变成可编辑文本框，带字数/行数、Ctrl+S 保存、重新载入，并用版本号防止覆盖磁盘上已被改动的文件；读写走插件自己的 Host 路由，只允许已登记工作区内的路径，保留 CRLF 与 BOM。

install: dsh plugin --profile web add github:<你的 GitHub 用户名>/dsh-novel-txt-editor
